analysis: Examined ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift against TB-012, A-018 and T-059 (add-on hold must keep models from loading beside VMs), plus T-041 hash/SSD bindings and T-029 availability. Head adds an add-on hold fence: (1) head 396-397 checks addonHoldLoadRefusal before isLoadingAny with no intervening suspension, so throwing there leaks no gate; the glmOwnership defer releases ownership. (2) Head 576-577 rechecks after hashing and hooks, inside the do/catch, so pending lease, modelsLoading and gate cleanup run (base 1009-1031). (3) The new modelLoadInterruption (head 1041-1048) replaces the shutdown/cancel checks at head 711 (after reducePendingLoad, releasing the newcomer and clearing the cache) and head 942 (unwinds under the reslice gate before slot install). This preserves CancellationError for stop/cancel and adds the hold refusal. These changes only add refusal points. Weight-hash bracketing, publication and cacheEligibleWeightHash logic (base 609-662) are unchanged, so T-041 bindings are unaffected. No regression was identified. Open questions for integration: (a) Head 1202-1203 drops the `servingDrain.owner != .addonHold` guard. Unload now calls persistLoadedModelSet during a hold, and the comment claims that function preserves the set. That implementation was not supplied. If it does not, a hold's temporary unload could erase the persisted serving set, which affects availability and startup preload, not confidentiality. (b) The managed Nemotron Super path (base 502-505) and the native MiMo path (base 507-511) return before the head 576 and 711 rechecks. A hold beginning during those loads relies on checks inside loadNemotronSuperSlot, loadNativeMiMoSlot and finishNativeMiMoSlotPublication, which were not supplied (T-059). (c) addonHoldLoadRefusal semantics and whether its error is non-unproven for GLM (base 990) were not visible. finishModelLoad after slot install (base 983) does not recheck the hold, so a hold beginning after install relies on the hold's own unload path.
